title: All-caps versus mixed-case text for low-vision and standard reading
statement:
While all-caps text is slightly more legible at the absolute threshold of visual acuity for low-vision users, mixed-case text is read significantly faster at standard web sizes due to distinct word shapes.

Options:
- Body Text Standard: Mixed-case (Sentence case) (fits: paragraphs, long form content, fast reading)
- Short Labels & Acronyms: All-caps (UPPERCASE) (fits: button labels, navigation items, alerts)
- Headings: Title Case (fits: hero headers, article titles)
- Stylistic UI: Lower-case only (fits: modern branding, minimalist design)
appliesWhen: Applies to: web, mobile, print. Audience: general, seniors, adults.

source.title: Letter case and text legibility in normal and low vision
